_about: The factual claims registry. Pages (hand-written or drafted by scripts/seo) may state only what is listed under `verified`. `banned` phrases fail validation. Update this file when a fact changes; every page is re-checked against it on each PR. `claim` is public (it is published in /llms.txt); `rule` is internal guidance for writers and is never published.

verified.claim: DOK has a free-for-life plan: 15 Intelligence-assisted consultations a month and unlimited manual records, no credit card.
Paid DOK starts from Rp60 ribu a month, with every module in one plan.
verified.rule: Do not quote any other DOK price.

verified.claim: DOK is live within 24 hours, guaranteed, or the first paid month is free. Migration from an old RME is free.
DOK is integrated with SATUSEHAT and BPJS (P-Care and Antrean). BPJS connections are activated per clinic with its own BPJS credentials.

DOK modules: consultation with DOK Intelligence (SOAP draft from a recorded consultation), e-prescription with drug-safety checks and the KFA catalogue, 7 speciality toolkits, maternity suite with KIA forms, front office (NIK registration, queue, booking), pharmacy and batch stock, cashier and billing, reports (LB1, Puskesmas reports, lab and radiology report reading), SATUSEHAT and BPJS.
DOK has 46 Indonesian guideline cards (PERKI, PERKENI, PAPDI, IDAI, POGI, PDGI and more).
SahAIbat Bidan covers ANC (10T), birth planning (P4K), postnatal care (KF1–KF4), family planning and contraception (WHO MEC), and child immunisation.
SahAIbat Kader helps Posyandu kaders record child growth with WHO z-scores and Permenkes 2/2020 categories, and plan follow-up and referral.
Kader, Bidan and SahAIbat field products work fully offline and sync when a signal returns. A full RME suite that also works offline is coming soon.
verified.rule: Say 'segera hadir' for the offline RME suite; never imply it is available.

verified.claim: Personal data and health records are stored in Indonesia, in data centres in Jakarta.
Identifying details (name, NIK, date of birth and the like) are never used to train models.
SahAIbat is registered in Indonesia under NIB 1202260248509 and as a PSE with Komdigi.
SahAIbat is built and operated by Viantra Health.
verified.rule: Name the company as Viantra Health. Do not use the numbered company name.

verified.claim: SahAIbat is a member of NVIDIA Inception.
Every draft from SahAIbat Intelligence is reviewed and signed by a health worker; it makes no automated clinical decisions.
Official websites: www.sahaibat.com (company and guides), www.sahaibatdok.com (SahAIbat DOK) and konsensus.id (Konsensus.id).
DOK Companion is a Chrome extension that adds DOK Intelligence to an RME a doctor already uses.
The SATUSEHAT integration uses the HL7 FHIR R4 standard.
SahAIbat products: Kader, Bidan, DOK, DOK Companion, Kasih, Code and Konsensus.id.

banned.reason: Never say AI. Use Intelligence, SahAIbat Intelligence or DOK Intelligence.
Never say AI in any form.

banned.pattern: analisis gambar|image analysis|baca rontgen|membaca foto rontgen
banned.reason: Image analysis is not built; only lab and radiology report reading.
Controls are aligned with ISO, not certified.
No guarantees of rankings or clinical outcomes.
Prices must match the registry (Rp60 ribu). Checked separately.
